The ticket number is **PD-4821**. I've posted it as a reply to Tobias's message in #central-random.

Hollis said in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026 that the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. Tobias is in #central-team, so he could see this himself, and ticket numbers are fine to share in the channel.

In the reply I also mentioned an open issue for the weekly notes: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports, to avoid duplicates. I didn't find any later update in that channel on whether it was fixed.
